description: This file defines multiple Orleans grain interfaces related to deadlock testing and call chain observation, including reentrancy control mechanisms and observer interfaces.

methods.name: CallNext_1
methods.description: Asynchronous method to continue the call chain with specified index and chain details.

methods.name: CallNext_2
methods.description: Asynchronous method to continue the call chain with specified index and chain details.

methods.name: OnEnter
methods.description: Handler invoked when entering a grain call, providing grain identifier and call index.

methods.name: OnExit
methods.description: Handler invoked when exiting a grain call, providing grain identifier and call index.

methods.name: CallChain
methods.description: Method to initiate a call chain with an observer, chain configuration, and call index.

methods.name: UnblockWaiters
methods.description: Method annotated with AlwaysInterleave attribute, presumably to unblock waiting tasks.
